status: engineering calculation from research/loads.md section 6 and research/components-electronics.md; no measurement on hardware

charging.note: loads.md quotes about 6 h with a 1 A charger; the 1.5 A charger reaches float sooner but absorption still dominates the tail.

fuses.note: Sized for the 20 A switch and the 16 AWG lead rather than for the load; loads.md section 6 would allow 7.5 A. The larger fuse still protects the 16 AWG (22 A chassis) cable.

fuses.circuit: charge port branch to the battery side of SW1

fuses.note: 0.65 A idle, 1.4 A if every 5 V load peaks together.

fuses.circuit: 6 V regulator U6 input (left and centre feet)
fuses.note: Four motors at the DRV8833 1 A limit.

fuses.circuit: 6 V regulator U7 input (right foot and head)
fuses.note: Three motors at the 1 A limit.

fuses.circuit: 5 V dome feed through the slip ring
fuses.note: 17 NeoPixels at 60 mA (1.02 A) plus four backpacks (0.50 A) plus the TFT (0.10 A). loads.md proposed a 1.5 A polyfuse, which the worst case exceeds; a 2 A blade fuse is used instead.

fuses.circuit: 12 V actuator driver U10 (DRV8871), revision D
fuses.note: Actuator stall is 1.0 A at 12 V and the DRV8871 limit is set to 0.895 A by R5. Not in loads.md; sized at twice the stall current.

wire_ampacity.used_for: battery, main fuse, switch, charge branch, regulator inputs, Pi 5 V feed
6 V branches, motor extensions, dome feed, display and NeoPixel signals
the motors' own factory leads and the slip-ring leads
wire_ampacity.verdict: pass at the DRV8833 1 A limit; keep these leads short (85 mV drop over 200 mm)

stance_change.status: revision D; mechanism values are the firmware MECHANISM CONSTANTS block in firmware/kb2040/stance.py, provisional until stance-mechanism reports

lock_switch.wiring: COM to GND, NO and NC to pulled-up inputs; right switch on STEMMA QT GP12/GP13

release_servo.kb2040_pins: D0 (GP0) left, D1 (GP1) right: both channels of PWM slice 0

centre_foot_feed.note: The kinematic command is below the TT gearbox minimum duty; whether the wheels turn at it is a commissioning check, not a verified result.

stance_change.U7_rail_note: Rail B carries 3 A of motors or, during a stance change, 3 A of servo stall; ground drive and the dome are refused whenever the servos can move.
stance_change.note: Ground drive and the dome are refused during a stance change, so the transition worst case does not add to the driving worst case.

notes: Motor currents come from loads.md section 2: 0.385 A per drive motor at 6 V on a hard floor, and 0.5 A at 3 V for the head drive.
The DRV8833 sense resistors chop each motor at 1 A, so a stall is a limit, not a fault current.
Runtime is to 50 percent depth of discharge, which is the figure that keeps an SLA's cycle life; running to 11.2 V gives more time and fewer cycles.
Every figure here is arithmetic on published ratings. Nothing has been measured on a built robot.
